description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for recipes using Room persistence library in Android. It includes methods for fetching all recipes, favorites, searching by query, getting by id, inserting, updating, and deleting recipes.

classes.name: RecipeDao
classes.description: Interface defining data access operations for recipe management in the database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all RecipeEntity records ordered by descending id.

methods.name: getFavorites
methods.description: Retrieves favorite recipes where isFavorite is 1, ordered by descending id.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for recipes where the title or description contains the query string.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a recipe by its id.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new recipe entity into the database, replacing on conflict.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing recipe entity in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a recipe entity from the database.
